definition: The entity Darryl Anka says he has channeled since 1983–84: a physical extraterrestrial hybrid 'first contact specialist' from a parallel-reality future, presented as an aspect of Anka's own future self. The name arrived with the first telepathic contact and is an Arabic word glossed as 'messenger' or 'bringer of good news'.

Canadian-born (Ottawa, Oct 12, 1951) film effects artist—model maker on Star Trek: The Motion Picture, miniatures on Iron Man and Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End—who began channeling Bashar after a 1983 channeling class, a decade after two 1973 daylight UFO sightings in Los Angeles. Co-founder of Zia Films and Bashar Communications.

The company (Bashar Communications, Inc.) formed by Darryl Anka and April Rochelle to record, publish and stream Bashar sessions; it runs events, private sessions, the online store and BasharTV, and states its purpose as catalysing 'new, transformative information by Bashar'.
Co-founder and CEO of Bashar Communications; producer of the 2016 documentary First Contact; reads audience questions to Bashar at live events.
Woodland Hills, California production company founded by Darryl Anka and his wife/producing partner Erica Jordan; produced Dearly Departed, First Contact and Alienated.
Darryl Anka's wife and producing partner; co-founder of Zia Films and producer of First Contact; a former dancer and Pilates instructor who handled the company's accounting.

Bashar's home world, glossed as 'place of living light', said to lie about 500 light-years away toward Orion but in a parallel reality invisible to us. Described as home to roughly 230 million telepathic hybrids, with a 25-hour day and three artificial moons (fan-wiki details).
The people of Essassani: a human–Grey (Zeta) hybrid race, about five feet tall with enlarged eyes and 'Eurasian' features, described as the third of five hybrid races. Bashar is one of them.
A name one fan wiki says Essassani adopted in mid-2013 after a 5th-to-6th-density shift. Not found in any official Bashar Communications source; treat as unconfirmed.

The fifth and most human-looking hybrid race, also called the Shalanaya/Shalinaya ('those who will come first'), which Bashar says will be the first civilization to make open contact with Earth. Fan sources attribute many UFO sightings (e.g., Phoenix Lights) to their craft.

Alternate name for the Yahyel, translated 'those who will come first'; in a 2009 session Bashar calls the Shalinaya the first ET civilization to have open contact with Earth. Not a separate race in the sources reviewed.

Bashar's ladder of human–Grey hybrid civilizations (session April 28, 2018, Anaheim): a failed first race, an ET-looking second, the Sassani third, an unnamed increasingly human fourth, and the Yahyel fifth—with humanity itself becoming the sixth.
Bashar's term for what humans are becoming: physically human but with enhanced empathic and psychic abilities and a stronger sense of unity, eventually blending with hybrid children living on Earth.

Human–ET offspring Bashar says are being raised on craft and will eventually live on Earth; a 2016 session ('Dear Mom and Dad') frames an open letter from them, says the first wave will arrive as teenagers, and references a group of 333.

The narrative that Zeta Reticuli Greys engineered hybrids from human and Grey DNA to restore their reproductive capacity, producing the Sassani and later races; Bashar uses it to explain abduction reports. Anka also says humanity is 'already hybridized'.

In Bashar's cosmology, 'humans from a parallel dimension' operating as a unified mass consciousness who created the Sassani by crossing human and Grey DNA; Bashar says his race are 'the children of the Greys / Zeta Reticulum and humans'.
A Bashar session title describing the Greys' federation and 'the parallel Earth that destroyed itself', used as a cautionary account of a civilization's collapse.

Bashar's self-described job: a member of a hybrid civilization tasked with preparing a planet for open contact. Event copy calls him 'a contact specialist … preparing Earth for extraterrestrial contact'; a 2015 session ('Substitute Teacher') is told from that role.

Anka's account that Bashar is his own future incarnation roughly 300 years ahead, in a parallel reality vibrating faster and about 3,000 years more developed; Baroni notes this mirrors Jane Roberts's Seth, who also claimed to be the medium's future self.

The larger soul-entity of which individual incarnations are simultaneous extensions; a term Bashar shares with the Seth material. Bashar Communications groups sessions under 'Soul & OverSoul' ('in our essence we are all connected').

Bashar's term for the totality of existence, expressed in the law 'The One is the All and the All are the One'; sessions such as 'The Structure of Existence' (2017) situate humanity within it. Also Seth-material vocabulary.

Bashar's stated immutable laws: (1) You exist; (2) Everything is here and now; (3) The One is the All and the All are the One; (4) What you put out is what you get back; (5) Everything changes except the first four laws.

The older/parallel four-item form (You exist; the One is All and the All are One; what you put out is what you get back; change is the only constant except the first three). BasharTV's introduction still calls the module 'The 4 Laws of Creation'.

Thirteen official statements (e.g., you are non-physical consciousness experiencing physical reality; you chose to be here; excitement is your true vibration; there is only one moment; everything you experience is another aspect of yourself; you are loved unconditionally).

Bashar's five-step practice: act on your highest excitement now; take it as far as you can; hold no insistence on outcomes; stay positive whatever happens; keep examining and replacing fear-based beliefs. Called the 'Essassani instruction manual'; expanded in Anka's 2024 book The Formula.

Whatever option, in the moment, carries the most excitement/passion; Bashar defines excitement as 'the physical translation of the vibrational resonance that is your true, core natural being' and treats it as a compass toward one's purpose.

From an August 1995 session: Vision, Desire, Belief, Acceptance, Intent, Action, Allowance—visualize, get excited, believe it possible, accept it as true, intend it, act as if it has manifested, then detach from the outcome.
The final manifestation step: detaching from how or when something arrives while keeping desire intense; also the theme of a 2015 session on applying surrender to magnify one's ability to act.

The ego-level mind designed to perceive and act within physical reality; Bashar says it can decide what you want but 'cannot know how' something will manifest, and produces polarized, fear-based responses when it tries to.

The non-physical aspect of self that operates outside time, knows the ideal outcome and handles the 'how'; it speaks to the physical mind through imagination and excitement, and functions as the 'holographic mirror' behind experience.

Described by Bashar as the pipeline through which the higher self communicates; Baroni notes Bashar's pun 'I-magi-nation' (a nation of magi) echoes Jacob Böhme's seventeenth-century wordplay on imagination as creative power.

Bashar's causal chain: experience is attracted by 'the interaction of your strongest beliefs, emotions and actions'; 'all emotions stem from beliefs'. To change a feeling, find the belief beneath it, own it, and replace it.

Beliefs 'not in alignment with who you prefer to be' that Formula step 5 asks people to keep investigating and replacing; Bashar treats fear as an alarm revealing a limiting belief rather than information about reality.
Bashar's claim that mere existence makes one worthy of anything desired; love is 'knowing everyone's deservability', guilt its opposite. Underpins the teaching that unworthiness is a chosen belief.

Any tool, ritual, object or technique (crystals, meditations, symbols, exercises) that a person uses to give themselves permission to access a state or ability they already possess; Bashar frames most spiritual methods as permission slips rather than causes.

One's chosen vibrational stance, which Bashar says determines experience regardless of circumstances ('circumstances don't matter, only state of being matters'); in the splitting-prism teaching a preferred state of being is 'the navigational device' into a matching parallel Earth.

Bashar's practice of redefining loaded words to change the beliefs behind them—e.g., doubt is 'one hundred percent trust in a belief you don't prefer', failure is giving up, hope implies doubt, 'try' presumes failure, unconditional love is granting validity to all beings.

The idea that events carry no inherent meaning; the meaning a person assigns (positive or negative) produces the effect. Bashar calls life 'fundamentally meaningless' and frames that as the gift enabling free choice.
Bashar's distinction between choosing what you prefer (valid) and invalidating what you do not (judgment); 'positive' is defined as that which integrates and 'negative' as that which separates.

Bashar's claim that every possible version of reality already exists; consciousness shifts between them billions of times per second, so continuity is an illusion and change means shifting to a version where the desired outcome 'already exists'.

Metaphor from the November 16, 2019 session: overlapping parallel realities on Earth are diverging like light through a prism, so people choosing different paths end up on 'many different versions of Earth'; a permission-slip tool was given for navigating it.
A 2020 Bashar tool 'for transforming your life during these challenging times', addressing the bifurcation of realities.
From the 2019 session 'Earth Zero': the notion that each moment 'the entire Earth shifts back to the zero template', a blank state from which every version of Earth is re-projected.

Bashar's teaching that only one moment exists ('Everything is here and now'); past and future are created from the present, time is 'an artificial construct created by collective human agreement', and the present 'is not the result of the past'.
Meaningful coincidence, which Bashar calls 'the organizing principle of the entire universe'; following the Formula is said to activate it.

Acting from excitement is said to draw supportive coincidences; acting from fear draws feared outcomes ('anti-synchronicity'). Bashar's 'red light/green light' version: repeated blocks are a signal to pivot toward what is open.
Basic Principle 2: humans were 'created in the image of the Creator', their essence is unconditional love, and 'the experience of ecstasy is your birthright'.
Defined by Bashar as 'the granting of validity for all beings to exist just as they are'; Principle 13 says Creation loves you so unconditionally that you may even believe you are unloved.

Bashar's definition: 'the ability to do what you need to do, when you need to do it', of which money is only one form; Principle 8 states you are naturally abundant and creation supports your choices.
A Bashar technique: imagine your ideal/'divine' self in the desired situation, observe how it feels, thinks and acts, and copy that behaviour exactly.

Bashar's scale of vibrational/dimensional levels used for civilizations and Earth's transition (e.g., Arcturians described as '8th density non-physical consciousness'; fan wikis place Essassani at 5th→6th; Q&A references 'fourth-density' beings). An official master list was not retrieved.

A Bashar framework of hierarchical consciousness levels and their relation to civilizational development, presented in 2011 sessions ('The Nine Levels of Consciousness', San Francisco; 'Diving Deeper Into the Nine Levels').

Bashar's umbrella term for Earth's accelerating transformation ('the big shift has begun'), in which humanity diverges into different versions of Earth; associated with 2012, the 2016–2020 windows and the 2020–2050 'reset'.

Bashar framed 2012 as a pivotal vibrational threshold and the year the 'hands-off quarantine' on Earth officially ends (2009 and 2011 sessions), later re-framed as an internal shift rather than a public event.
Bashar's claim that ET civilizations observed a non-interference policy toward Earth that 'officially ends' in 2012, opening the path toward gradual contact.
Bashar's name (session Dec 1, 2017) for the three years following fall 2016, 'a highly accelerated window of opportunity for discovery' of hidden truths and ET-related evidence.
Date from a 2014 Bashar session ('In your upcoming fall of 2016 EVERYTHING will change'), later treated as the start of the Window of Discovery rather than a discrete event.

Bashar's label (session June 17, 2018) for 2027 as 'a major turning point' in humanity's relationship with ETs, placed roughly 80 years after the 1947 Roswell incident within his 'cycles of timing' for open contact.
Bashar's use of the 1947 Roswell incident as the start of an ~80-year cycle culminating in 2027; Anka also cites '40-year cycles' of paradigm shift.
Session of June 21, 2019 in which Bashar said the social and political changes of 2020 'will affect the window of timing for open contact', which can accelerate or slow depending on human choices.

Bashar's term for publicly acknowledged, face-to-face relations between humanity and ET civilizations, expected to unfold gradually (sightings, acknowledgment, then meetings). Stated windows: 2023–2033, with 2026 as 'year of disclosure' and 2027 as the fulcrum; full integration over decades.
Session (Oct 9, 2016, Sedona) describing the phases, steps and procedures a civilization passes through during first contact, including timing mechanisms and adoption into an interstellar alliance.

The association of ET civilizations Bashar says humanity is being prepared to join; membership is framed as a matter of vibrational compatibility. Also discussed as a 'galactic federation' that treats nuclear weapons as an intervention threshold.

A multi-step program begun in 2024 in which Bashar releases cumulative exercises (belief changes, daily practices, service, group gatherings, ship-contact initiation) to align participants with the Alliance's frequency; contact is said to be possible 'between now and the next couple of decades'.

term: Guide to Open Contact (Window, Door, Gate)
definition: Bashar Communications' curated sequence of sessions—'Increasing the Probability of Contact', 'Tell Them Bashar Sent You', 'The Window, The Door & The Gate' and the three-part 'Becoming a Galactic Citizen'—describing stages of readiness for contact.
Bashar's term for a human who has adopted the outlook and behaviours compatible with membership in the interstellar community; the subject of the 'Becoming a Galactic Citizen' series.
related: Guide to Open Contact (Window, Door, Gate)

definition: Bashar's claim that Earth, Essassani and Sirius form a linked three-way consciousness relationship ('Nexus Point', 2012); fan wikis add a higher triad with Arcturus and Polaris, and a session discusses a 'future triad' involving Barnard's Star.

Star system whose civilization Bashar links to Earth's triad, to cetaceans (dolphins/whales) and to the origin of the Sacred Circuitry symbols; sessions include 'Reconnecting with Sirius' (Ixtapa, 2001) and 'Message from Sirius' (11-11-2012).

In Bashar's cosmology, ancient star systems that explored 'separation and limitation' under an oppressive government (planet Huva) resisted by the 'Black League'; that energy is said to have moved through Maldek and Mars to Earth's Middle East. Also the direction of Essassani.

Described by Bashar as ancient Lyrans (~300,000 strong) who arrived ~500,000 years ago and engineered Homo sapiens from Homo erectus ~300,000 years ago as a mining workforce, later becoming guides and leaving for Andromeda. Baroni notes this as the Sitchin-style layer of the cosmology.
The Lyra-origin civilization Bashar identifies as the source of the Anunnaki and thus of humanity's engineered ancestry; asked about in Q&A as the 'role of Lyrans in human evolution'.

Civilization Bashar presents as the 'integration and unity' counterpart to Orion's separation, with a long connection to humanity ('Pleiades: The Seven Sisters'); Q&A often asks how the Yahyel differ from Pleiadians.
Described in a Bashar session ('Bashar on Arcturus: The Gate Keepers') as 8th-density non-physical consciousness; fan wikis place Arcturus in a higher triad linked to Earth's.

A nine-point map Bashar used in a three-part September 2014 weekend to relate civilizations connected to Earth (Essassani, Pleiadians, Sirians, Arcturians, Anunnaki, Zeta/Greys, Orion, Reptilians, Yahyel) and to 'protosapien'/'hypersapien' stages.

Three artificially intelligent spheres (fan wikis: artificial moons ~75 miles across) said to encircle and energetically balance Essassani, maintain a relationship with Earth and help synchronize human brainwaves; each was the subject of a 2017 session.

A second entity Anka channels: 'a channeled human-alien hybrid and parallel reality specialist who lives on Earth 700 years in our future', introduced in 'The 33rd Parallel' (Sedona, April 13, 2013) and featured in the 'Willa's World' meditations and Anka's Shards of a Shattered Mirror novels.
A BasharTV series of guided meditations and 'Five Levels of Mastery' energy practices, channeled as Willa, focused on nature consciousness (forest, animal and elemental 'paths').
A progression of practices delivered through Willa (sessions 2016–2018) for deepening connection with nature and multidimensional awareness; 'The First Level of Mastery' was a 2018 session.
Darryl Anka's novel series (Book I Cryptic, Book II Nocturnal) set 700 years in the future and featuring Willa; Anka read chapters aloud at sessions between 2015 and 2019.

Per a 2016 Las Vegas session, 'the Sassani word for the number 13, the vibration of transformation', taught through an ancient Essassani game combining play with density and crystal concepts; also the name used in a YouTube video 'Cybo from E'sassani channeled by Darryl Anka'.
A Sassani-related name appearing in a Bashar/Anka video title ('Bashar x Darryl Anka on Shivai (Sassanni)'); no accessible source explains it. Include only as an attested term.

A set of 15 glyphs Bashar introduced (2010) said to originate with the Sirians; viewing them up to three times daily for at most 15 minutes is claimed to 'rewire' neural circuitry, boost synchronicity and support contact readiness. Sold as cards.
The guided meditation that closes most Bashar events, described as 'a Transformative Experience of Light, Color and Sound'—a synergy of light, colour, sound, form and beauty.

A December 9, 2015 Sedona session unveiling 'a project to further the acceleration of ET contact' using Sedona's vortex sites; fan wikis say the Essassani and Yahyel began 'energizing' the vortex on Dec 7, 2014.

Locations Bashar says are energetic gateways; a 2018 session names 'the five most important vortices and interdimensional portals in the Western United States', and Sedona is treated as a primary one.
A 2006 Bashar session proposing legislation to establish formal contact protocols with extraterrestrial beings—part of Bashar's 'contact politics' strand alongside the 2012 'UFO Witness Declaration'.
A 2012 session/initiative marking Bashar's 'increased involvement in disclosure and contact politics'.
A 2016 audience 'experiment' Bashar proposed to 'increase the probability' of ET contact through collective participation.

Bashar's framing (April 25, 2020) of 2020 and the pandemic as 'a pivotal point in human history' where 'the prism is splitting'; a five-step permission-slip technique was offered for passing through it.

A January 25, 2025 Bashar event on 'consequential secrets' coming to light at personal, societal and governmental levels; often conflated online with a '2023 no more secrets' prediction, which is not supported by the official listing.
Anka's summary of Bashar's timeline: a 30-year 'reset' of human civilization from 2020 to 2050, followed by mainstream acceptance of ET contact and gradual integration into 'galactic society'.
A December 2025 podcast framing of Bashar's view that 2025–2027 is a 'global breakdown phase' of collapsing systems that precedes breakthrough and open contact.

The live Q&A segment of every event: after Bashar's monologue, attendees selected by raffle ask questions (read by April Rochelle), followed by a closing meditation; livestream viewers may submit questions by chat.

Bashar Communications' streaming platform and app (tv.bashar.org): rentals, purchases and live-stream subscriptions ('BTV Live + Shorts' $39.99/mo, 'BTV Live' $35/mo, 'BTV Shorts' $4.99/mo; past recordings not included).

A June 20, 2009 session in which Bashar argues that 'gullibility, skepticism and cynicism all represent essentially the same rejection of truth'—his stated stance on how to evaluate claims, including his own.

Bashar's definition: selecting what you prefer without invalidating alternatives. The official 'Message from Bashar' says no belief system is presented 'as being more valid than any other' because 'all truths are true'.

Francesco Baroni's 2012 analysis that Bashar's system rests on Hermetic/Neoplatonic motifs—unity of creation, holographic microcosm, imagination as creative power—repackaged in an alien narrative and New Age idiom, with Seth-material vocabulary.

The observation (Baroni 2012) that Bashar closely parallels Jane Roberts's Seth material (1963–84): shared terms 'All That Is' and 'Oversoul', reality-creation doctrine, and the claim that the entity is the channel's future self.

Darryl Anka's two daytime sightings in one week in 1973 over Los Angeles of a dark, metallic, equilateral triangular craft (~30 ft per side) at about 150 ft and then 70 ft, with family and friends present—the origin story of his metaphysical research.

Zia Films/Bashar Communications documentary (95 min; premiered June 2016; US digital release Sept 16, 2016) written and directed by Anka, produced with Erica Jordan and April Rochelle, narrated by James Woods, covering the sightings, channeling and an EEG study.

Bashar: Blueprint for Change — A Message from Our Future (Dec 1990, New Solutions Publishing, ed. Luana Ewing, 302 pp.), the best-known Bashar book, containing monologues and dialogues on psychology, planetary evolution, metaphysics and ET contact—and several dated forecasts later judged failed.

Darryl Anka's 2020 book (Virtualbookworm, 104 pp.) subtitled 'An ET's Observations on Earth', presenting humanity's society from an extraterrestrial observer's viewpoint; categorised as alien-contact science fiction.
Anka's 2024 book (BookBaby, 102 pp.) proposing a 'Unified Theory of Metaphysics' that gives modern, precise explanations of spiritual phenomena intended to bridge metaphysics and physical science.

Bashar Communications labels everything 'for educational purposes only' with no accuracy guarantees; Anka says 'I can't prove any of this' and that value lies in results when applied. A widely quoted line 'don't believe anything Bashar says just because he says it' was not found verbatim on official pages.
